subject.title: Autoreview rejects safe provider credential references and test placeholders

question: Should the credential scanner accept the exact provider/session source expressions and explicit test fixtures proposed by this issue while continuing to reject all other credential-shaped assignments?
rationale: The reported false positives are narrow, but every new exception changes a fail-closed secret-review boundary and needs a maintainer to select the permanent policy.

options.title: Approve exact exceptions
options.body: Allow only the enumerated TypeScript member-read shapes and `test-key`, `test-secret`, and `test-token` fixtures with regression coverage for unsafe near-matches.

options.title: Keep current fail-closed policy
options.body: Reject these values unless callers adopt a different review-bundle representation that preserves the existing scanner boundary.

recommendation.title: Approve exact exceptions
recommendation.body: Allow only the enumerated TypeScript member-read shapes and `test-key`, `test-secret`, and `test-token` fixtures with regression coverage for unsafe near-matches.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced and recently maintained the autoreview scanner path that defines this policy boundary.
